
{{alias}}( executor )
    Promise constructor polyfill.

    Parameters
    ----------
    executor: Function
        Function invoked immediately with `resolve` and `reject` callbacks.

    Returns
    -------
    out: Promise
        Promise instance.

    Examples
    --------
    > function executor( resolve ) { resolve( 'beep' ); };
    > var p = new {{alias}}( executor )
    <Promise>

    See Also
    --------
